name: Flunklug
summary:
**Some scrap is worth the risk. You'll find out which.**

Flunklug is a multiplayer co-op horror game about stealing what isn't yours. Break into facilities, caverns and worse with your friends, grab everything of value you can carry, and get out before the things down there catch you first.
# Sell scrap and buy items
Every escape pays for the next. Haul your scraps back out and sell them, unlock new gadgets and weapons, and gear up to push deeper than the run before.
